rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00021567, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=46, rationale=iter-19 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). FIFTH bs=2 seed replicate of the c24/ep5/bs2/lr2.16e-4 champion config. ONE KNOB: seed 45 -> 46. All else = iter-7/16/17/18 config exactly. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) bs=2 4-point spread: s42 0.8469, s43 0.6699, s44 0.8277, s45 0.8402 -> mean 0.7962 +/- 0.075. Three of four seeds cluster in 0.83-0.85; s43 (0.6699) is a low outlier. Adding s46 to firm up the mean and reduce the outlier's leverage. (2) FAILURE MODE: high generalization variance intrinsic to itnet_v3 breast (confirmed at both bs); more seeds tighten the reportable mean+/-std. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 45 -> 46 (5th bs=2 point). (4) HYPOTHESIS: n/a (variance replicate); s46 refines the 5-point bs=2 mean+/-std. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): bs=2 = 939.5-1096.9s across prior runs, all < 1200s. max_train_s=1100 fences the TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-19 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-20 (FINAL).
